title: kate-ui: show the completion popup
summary: ctrl-space opens a popup under the caret with word_completions from the buffer, merged with the server items when a completion response arrives. Up and down move, enter and tab insert the suffix of the selected item through Command::InsertText, escape closes, and typing filters the items by the new prefix.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
/// The word characters before `at`, used as the completion prefix.
fn completion_prefix(buf: &kate_text::TextBuffer, at: kate_text::Offset) -> String

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: ctrl-space no longer sends Command::CompleteWord from the window; it opens the popup with popup_from_words(word_completions(buf, caret, 20), 20) and, when a client is up, requests textDocument/completion for the caret and merges requests::completion_labels of the Response with merge_completions. Enter or tab runs Command::InsertText(suffix_for(accepted, prefix)) when Some and closes. The popup is anchored to the caret bounds. completion_prefix walks back over Unicode letters, digits, underscore, and apostrophe like kate-core's word rule. The test completion_prefix_stops_at_a_space asserts completion_prefix of foo ba with the caret at the end is ba and of foo  at the end is empty. The owner types and completes a word. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::completion_prefix_stops_at_a_space
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because completion_prefix does not exist. After the change the prefix is the word before the caret and empty after a space.
